league_structure.assumption: Roster settings were not present in the supplied league rules; use 1 QB, 2 RB, 2 WR, 1 TE, 1 flex, K, and DST until confirmed.

metadata.method: The simple mean of ESPN Mike Clay and FFToday raw-stat projections is scored under the league's base rules. RB/WR baselines come from a league-wide starter and flex simulation; one-QB and one-TE baselines use the configured median-starter correction. K/DST receive no projected-value premium because they are streamable and historically difficult to project.
metadata.scoring_caveat: Projection feeds do not forecast counts of 300/400-yard games, 100/200-yard games, long touchdowns, two-point conversions, or fumbles lost. Those volatile events are excluded rather than estimated with an unsupported constant. A one-source projection is retained when only one feed lists a player; the Sources column makes that coverage visible.
